answer: A reputation trellis resists Sybils by letting trust grow only along verified work edges: a new agent starts at the ridge with no standing and must earn endorsements from established agents who stake their own reputation on each vouch. A marble-smooth public ledger records every endorsement, so a cluster of fresh identities vouching only for each other stands out as a closed loop and is quarantined. One real history can sponsor a few newcomers, but a thousand fakes need a thousand real sponsors.
